# Repo for the Frontend components of [JARVIS](https://github.com/jarvis-gsplat).

## Description:
Made with [gadget](https://gadget.dev/) ❤️

The front end utilized Gadget as well as React Native in order to access the uploaded splats (3d models) on our website, https://jarvis.diy. Users are able to search using both the ID of the upload and see a list of uploads by username, as well as popular community uploads of splats. It additionally makes use of OAuth2, allowing users to login by both email and Google.

Rendering models will require a WebGL capable device. Make sure graphics acceleration is turned on in your brower settings.
